create_JobConfig: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem training job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_SchedulerConfig: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure local or SLURM scheduling with node count and distributed init method
create_SlurmConfig: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to configure SLURM job parameters like memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition
review_SchedulerType: review the SchedulerType enum to choose between LOCAL and SLURM scheduler modes for job execution
review_DeviceType: review the DeviceType enum to choose between CPU and CUDA device types for fairchem jobs
